CommercialActivity.title: Commercial Activity
CommercialActivity.description: A market-facing (commerciële) activity offered by a Dutch bestuursorgaan (gemeente, provincie, waterschap, GR) under the Wet Markt en Overheid (Mededingingswet hfd. 4b). Each activity is a first-class WMO register record carrying ACM meldingstatus, kostprijsmethode, kostenplaats/kostendrager coupling and the optional algemeen-belang-besluit exemption link (REQ-WMO-001). Splits, IKP calculation and ACM reporting all scope to this record. A customer/afnemer is a Nextcloud contact entity, not a bespoke schema — afnemers holds the external references only.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this activity for tenant isolation (REQ-WMO-001).

code.description: Operator-assigned unique code within the administration (e.g. MO-SP-014 = Markt Ondernemen-Sporten).

naam.description: Human-readable name of the commercial activity.

bestuursorgaan.description: The bestuursorgaan operating the activity (gemeente/provincie/waterschap/GR name or FK).

beschrijving.description: Description of the goods/services offered on the market.

marktsegment.description: Market segment in which the activity competes.

concurrenten.description: Named private competitors operating in the same market segment.

afnemers.description: Known customers/buyers. Each afnemer is a Nextcloud contact entity reference, not a bespoke schema.

startDatum.description: Effective start date of the commercial activity.

eindDatum.description: Closure date, if the activity has ended.

kostprijsMethode.description: Cost-price methodology. Integrale kostprijs (Art. 25i) is the default; the monitor-variant without winstopslag is only valid under an algemeen-belang-besluit exemption.

kostenplaatsCode.description: FK to CostCenter.code (bookkeeping-cost-centers-dimensions); the direct-cost source for IKP calculation.

kostendragerCode.description: FK to KostenDrager.code (bookkeeping-cost-centers-dimensions); the commerciële sub-administratie dimension.

isExempted.description: Whether the activity is exempted from the gedragsregels via an algemeen-belang-besluit.

exemptionBesluitId.description: FK to AlgemeenBelangBesluit.id when isExempted is true (Phase 2).

acmMelding.description: ACM notification status for the activity.

ingediend.description: Whether the activity has been reported to the ACM.

lastReviewedAt.description: Timestamp of the last annual compliance review. Drives the stale-activity review-task generator (REQ-WMO-001c): a task is generated when this is more than 365 days old.

IntegralCostPrice.title: Integral Cost Price
IntegralCostPrice.description: A time-versioned, immutable record of the integrale kostprijs (IKP, Art. 25i) for one commercial activity in one period (REQ-WMO-002). Each period (month/quarter/year) produces a record with status voorlopig (monthly) or definitief (year-end 31-Mar lock). Components follow the six statutory IKP groups: directe loonkosten, directe materialen, directe afschrijvingen, indirecte overhead (via BBV taakveld 0.4 sleutel), vermogenskosten (WACC) and winstopslag. Prior records remain immutable for audit; a restatement is a new record, never a mutation.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning the activity for tenant isolation.

berekendOp.description: Timestamp the calculation was run (or the accountant sign-off timestamp for a definitief lock).

status.description: voorlopig = provisional monthly calculation; definitief = year-end (31-Mar) accountant-signed lock.

componenten.description: The six statutory IKP cost components in EUR.

indirecteOverhead.description: Indirect overhead allocated via the BBV taakveld 0.4 sleutel.

vermogenskosten.description: Cost of capital via WACC rate.

totaleKosten.description: Sum of all components in EUR.

verkochteEenheden.description: Units sold/delivered in the period (for per-unit costing).

gehanteerdTarief.description: Actual price charged to customers, used for the compliance check.

marge.description: gehanteerdTarief minus (kostprijsPerEenheid or totaleKosten). Must be >= 0 to be compliant.

compliant.description: True when gehanteerdTarief >= kostprijsPerEenheid (or totaleKosten when no units tracked) — Art. 25i cost-coverage.

toelichting.description: Notes on cost-center scope, allocation method and assumptions.

ActivityCostAllocation.title: Activity Cost Allocation
ActivityCostAllocation.description: A reversible, immutable split record describing how a journal-entry line touching a commercial activity is divided across publieke and commerciële sub-administraties per the geldende OverheadDistributionRule (AllocationRule) for the posting date (REQ-WMO-003). The journal entry itself is never mutated; the split is derived for reporting (or optionally materialised as balanced GL lines). A handmatige override requires verplichte motivering and 4-ogen-akkoord (two approver user-ids); the original is marked status=overridden and a new record carries automatischToegepast=false.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning the activity for tenant isolation.

journalEntryId.description: FK to the journal entry / GL line being split.

commercialActivityId.description: FK to the CommercialActivity matched by kostenplaats/kostendrager code.

originalAmount.description: Total transaction amount in EUR being split.

splits.description: The resulting split lines; ratios sum to 1.0 and amounts sum to originalAmount.

kostendrager.description: Target KostenDrager.code for the split line.

grootboek.description: Optional target GL account for the split line.

automatischToegepast.description: True for an automatic split; false when manually overridden.

status.description: active = current; overridden = superseded by a manual split; reversed = source transaction reversed.

handmatigeOverride.description: Present when automatischToegepast is false: the 4-ogen-akkoord and motivering.

Commerciële exploitatie van parkeerplaatsen in de centrumgarage voor langparkeerders.
Commerciële verwerking van extern slib op de afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallatie voor derden.
